Strategy: Quadratic peak at three item sizes: score falls with the squared distance between a bin's residual and 3*item, so the preferred bin leaves exactly two item-sized gaps after placement, keeping room for two more same-size items; the squared penalty punishes far-off bins much more than near ones. It can fail when items vary, since the reserved double gap rarely matches the next items.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-((r - 3 * item) ** 2) for r in bins]
```
